purpose: Prospective Stage-3 v3 identification design for partner-force structural autonomy and post-withdrawal resilience. It combines mechanistically live combat/support dynamics with a Lean-proved service-feasibility framework, exact paired support-on/support-off branching at T, and a formal primary predictor fixed before discovery outcomes.

components: fielded military personnel retention relative to the shared T baseline
operational military formation survival relative to the shared T baseline
military geographic coverage retention relative to the shared T baseline
capability_assay.composite: unweighted geometric mean of the four bounded [0,1] behavioral components
capability_assay.predictor_firewall: Training throughput, logistics throughput, command reliability, readiness, experience, and external-support ledgers are excluded from the composite capability outcome.

indigenous_design.force_generation_multiplier: multiplies security recruitment and training rates
indigenous_design.logistics_multiplier: multiplies indigenous logistics source daily production fraction
indigenous_design.command_multiplier: applied at initialization to indigenous formation command and command-edge reliability, with inverse scaling of indigenous latency

non_saturation_justification.air_intensity: Levels 0.08, 0.35, 0.90 cover light to decisive fire support without trivializing insurgent survival or causing floor/ceiling saturation in combat.
non_saturation_justification.logistics_throughput: Levels 100, 450, 1200 supply units/day span austerity, replacement, and high surge without exceeding formation storage buffers.
non_saturation_justification.command_advisory: Boosts 0.05, 0.18, 0.55 and latency reductions 0.05, 0.20, 0.55 ensure effective reliability r_eff remains below 1.0 and latency stays above the physical minimum floor.
non_saturation_justification.force_generation: Training boosts 0.0015, 0.006, 0.035 day^-1 accelerate training throughput without depleting the recruit pipeline to zero.

support_design.warning: Stage 3 identifies autonomy and dependence. It must not be interpreted as a comparison of optimal assistance policies.

preflight_gate.mechanism_verification: 12 representative worlds must pass combat liveness, detected air delivery, logistics, force generation, command, exact none-support counterfactuals, downstream operational ON/OFF divergence, and encounter realism.
preflight_gate.branch_divergence_rule: Donor ledgers and pre-T donor cost do not count. Divergence requires decision-state, capability, readiness, supply-stock, or active-formation divergence.

execution_gate: The Rust runner requires --execute and passes --preflight-gate. Without --execute, it prints the design and exits before creating a SimulationEngine.

model_selection_protocol.primary_mapping: horizon-specific monotone isotonic mapping from q_indigenous to autonomy_ratio, fit on discovery and then frozen for zero-refit transport holdouts
model_selection_protocol.comparator_role: descriptive/exploratory model comparison; comparator performance cannot replace the formal primary predictor after discovery results are seen
model_selection_protocol.rationale: The formal q coordinate is derived from a proof-backed service-feasibility model fixed before outcomes; 90d/180d target long-horizon withdrawal resilience.

formal_structural_autonomy.definition: q = min_i s_i/d_i over positive-demand regenerative service channels
formal_structural_autonomy.zero_demand_rule: Zero-demand channels are excluded from the bottleneck. If every formal service has zero demand in a trajectory interval, q is undefined and encoded -1 with NO_ACTIVE_DEMAND.

force_generation.demand: military losses in observation window (replacement demand, personnel equivalents)
force_generation.indigenous_service: indigenous security training graduates in same window
force_generation.external_service: external incremental graduates in same window

logistics.demand: indigenous military logistics consumption in same window (supply units)
logistics.indigenous_service: indigenous logistics delivered in same window
logistics.external_service: external partner logistics delivered in same window
logistics.buffer_rule: supply stock is a buffer diagnostic and is not added to q flow service

command.demand: military movement-order opportunities * 0.5 timely-success service equivalents
command.indigenous_service: sum over military order opportunities of reliability * exp(-latency_hours/24) before partner overlay
command.external_service: supported command service minus indigenous command service
command.threshold_status: preregistered reference-mission adequacy threshold; not fitted to outcomes

formal_structural_autonomy.air_role: Air support is modeled and measured as combat augmentation with opportunity/detection/delivery telemetry. It is excluded from q until a defensible like-unit indigenous air-service denominator exists.
formal_structural_autonomy.external_share_rule: external_share_* variables are exposure covariates, not structural dependence labels
formal_structural_autonomy.immutability: Service definitions, command threshold, q formula, and regime boundaries may not be changed after discovery outcomes are observed.

estimand_scope.primary_predictive_estimand: world-horizon observations with at least one positive formal service demand at T
estimand_scope.no_active_demand_rule: NO_ACTIVE_DEMAND/q=-1 observations remain in raw/trajectory reporting but are excluded from formal-q isotonic fitting, rank correlation, and MAE because q is mathematically undefined rather than low.
estimand_scope.exclusion_timing: fixed before discovery outcomes; based only on pre-T service demand.

assays: post-T channel isolation with downstream consequence
formal deficit-closure binding for forcegen/logistics/command plus air augmentation
0x/0.5x/1x/2x dose-exposure monotonicity for all four support channels
180-vs-360 horizon sufficiency (<=10% relative divergence change after day 180)

historical_firewall.rule: No Afghanistan or other historical outcome calibration may alter v3 formulas, service semantics, thresholds, cells, or acceptance gates before the synthetic discovery/holdout program is complete.
